_comment: OPTIONAL. Reuse markdown you already summarize elsewhere as briefing segments, instead of re-fetching + re-summarizing (saves AI cost). Copy to local_sources.json (gitignored). Delete the file or set every folder enabled:false to disable. base_dir can also come from the LOCAL_MARKDOWN_DIR env var (or the legacy PONTUS_VAULT_DIR) — the env var overrides base_dir, but you still configure your folders here.
